Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's Birth Anniversary Observed

The birth anniversary of Bankim Chandra Chatterjee, the composer of 'Vande Mataram', was observed. Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tributes to Chatterjee on this occasion. Chatterjee is known for his significant contribution to Indian literature and national sentiment through his works.
